subject: Looking for a statistics using R teacher

messages.author: bf424a87bbd56e50
messages.subject: Looking for a statistics using R teacher
parts:
Hi there,

First of all, as an R addict and an India lover, I'm really happy to see that an R group exists in Bangalore !!

I'm a post-doc fellow in the Ecology lab at the French Institute of Pondicherry where we are wondering about the opportunity to find somebody for a (1:4) x 1 week session of statistics formation (let's say from the very basics to GLM) combined with R introduction. Typically the format of Crawley's R Book would be perfect ! Naturally, we will fund that and provide all facilities if we find the right person ;)

Do you guys have an idea where to find this absolute gem? Maybe in the Bangalore's RUG itself? Elsewhere?
Feel free to contact me if you are interested and of course, spread the world more specifically or to others mail-lists that I may not know.

Thanks a lot for your help!
All the best,

V.



--
Department of Ecology
French Institute of Pondicherry, India
www.ifpindia.org
